question.text: Under SEBI (PM) Regulations 2020, derivatives in fixed-income PMS strategies are primarily used for:

answer.text: Hedging of portfolio risks and duration management

explanation.text: The Logic: Regulatory frame: derivatives for hedging, duration management, and rebalancing — with investor consent and documented in DD. The Trap: Speculation / leverage-chasing is not the regulatory intent of derivatives in PMS. Cross-Exam Context: XXI-A tests this from Distributor side; XXI-B tests PM-side compliance. Manager's Pro-Tip: Document the derivative strategy in the PMS DD and obtain specific client authorisation — SEBI inspections check this routinely.
